description: Delete one of your own feed posts (id from list_my_activity). The bottle stays on your shelf. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

confirm_token.description: Omit on the first call to get a preview. After the user agrees, call again with identical arguments plus this token.

name: delete_my_activity
